test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks, will complete the letter series.

_ R _ _ A R _ O _ _ G O A _ G O

options.text: A G O G R A A
A G O G A R R
A A G O G R R
A G G O A R R

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: _ R _ _ A R _ O _ _ G O A _ G O

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) A G O G R A A → __A__ R __G__ __O__ / A R __G__ O / **__R__** **__A__** G O / A **__A__** G O

**Option 2) A G O G A R R **→ __**A**__ R __**G**__ __**O**__ / A R __**G**__ O / __**A**__ __**R**__ G O / A __**R**__ G O

Option 3) A A G O G R R → __A__ R **__A__** **__G__** / A R **__O__** O / **__G__** __R__ G O / A __R__ G O

Option 4) A G G O A R R → __A__ R __G__ **__G__** / A R **__O__** O / __A__ __R__ G O / A __R__ G O

Here, '**Option 2**' followed a pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
